structural_failures_detected.allowed_statement: Automated structural screening detected the listed machine-checkable failures.
proves: the listed checks failed in this scorer run
does_not_prove: the complete set of accessibility defects

no_structural_failures_detected.allowed_statement: Automated structural screening found no failures among the checks it performed.
proves: the narrow catalog-level checks in structural_screen_v1 passed

machine_validation_passed.allowed_statement: A named, versioned validator passed its declared machine-verifiable profile.
proves: only the machine-verifiable rules in the exact recorded validator profile

human_review_completed.allowed_statement: A traceable human review completed the declared checklist and scope.
proves: only the reviewed items, document hash, standard edition, and scope in that record

conformance_validated.allowed_statement: Conformance was validated against the named standard edition using the recorded machine and human evidence.
proves: the bounded validation conclusion supported by the retained evidence

certified_conformance.allowed_statement: A named external authority issued the retained certificate for this exact document hash and scope.
proves: only what the authentic certificate states

automated_lane_capability.reason: Version 1 deliberately has no authenticated ingestion path for validator, human-review, or certification evidence. Supplied claims are retained only as rejected input and cannot promote an assessment.
